title: English Journey Diagnostic Test
description: This test mixes A1 and A2 topics to estimate your starting level. There is no pass/fail score — answer honestly to get the best placement.
notes: Each question includes an estimatedBand (A1 or A2) based on topic difficulty. Score A1 questions separately from A2 questions to estimate placement.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation: With I, use am.

questions.question: Choose the word that correctly completes the sentence: ___ he your brother? — Yes, he is.
questions.explanation: Invert am/is/are and the subject for yes/no questions. Wh- questions start with What, Where, Who, How, etc. + am/is/are + subject.

questions.question: What does "person" mean?
questions.explanation: "person" → pessoa.

questions.question: Complete: We ___ a small car.
questions.explanation: Have with I, you, we, they. Has with he, she, it. Questions and negatives use do/does + base have: Does he have a bike?

questions.question: Complete: ___ study every day.
questions.explanation: Daily routines and permanent situations: add -s for he/she/it.

questions.question: Complete: She ___ a teacher.
questions.explanation: Use is with he/she/it.

questions.question: Which sentence is grammatically correct?
questions.explanation: Correct pattern for Past Simple — Regular Verbs: Regular past: add -ed (work → worked, play → played). Pronunciation: /t/, /d/, /ɪd/.

questions.question: Choose the word that correctly completes the sentence: ___ moved last year.
questions.explanation: Last + period: last month, last year | … ago: three years ago | In + past year: in 2019 | On + past day: on Monday (finished)

questions.question: What does "arrangement" mean?
questions.explanation: "arrangement" → combinado.

questions.question: Complete: This ___ the best pizza in town.
questions.explanation: The + -est (the oldest) or the most + adj (the most interesting).
